text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf's vice-president and right hand, Air Groove, worries for her wellbeing since she insists on balancing her student council duties with a grueling training schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The other vice-president, Narita Brian, comes off as blunt at first, but she clearly cares for the student council's new general manager.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf seems delighted to have people looking up to her. Over the course of the day, I catch a glimpse of her relationships with the other student council members.
